selection_lists.label: Tyler's five February 2018 Wii U exclusivity candidates
selection_lists.subject: Tyler
selection_lists.summary: Initial five proposed lasting-exclusivity candidates, immediately qualified as possible ports. Not current exclusivity facts, not a favorites ranking, and not the separate Nintendo Land suggestion.
selection_lists.ordering: Spoken presentation order, not a certainty or quality ranking.
